svg.title: How Storage Scale System serves your data
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Active file management brings data from other storage and clouds into one namespace. Storage Scale System serves it from NVMe flash over POSIX, NFS, SMB, S3 and more. NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage sends it straight to GPU memory, past the host CPU and DRAM.
